note: Verifies (1) which distro container images ship the systemd 261 binaries, and (2) which systemd version each distro packages right now. Deterministic: version strings + file-presence booleans, no timing. No statistical distribution applies. Sources of truth: probe-result.json + probe-pkg-result.json.

new_surface_cited_from_news: systemd-imdsd (local Varlink IPC API exposing IMDS to local programs)
systemd-imds (client that imports IMDS fields into system credentials)
systemd-sysinstall (textual OS installer wrapping repart + bootctl + creds)
systemd-tpm2-swtpm.service (software TPM fallback via IBM swtpm)
dlopen()-based linking for all external libs except libc
LUO/Kexec Handover, ConditionFraction=, ConditionMachineTag=, BPF LSM RestrictFileSystemAccess=

binary_presence_matrix.method: docker run <image> then `command -v` / check /usr/lib/systemd for each binary; unit-file presence for the .service
binary_presence_matrix.note: fedora/ubuntu/debian rows are all-false because those minimal container images do not install systemd at all (see packaged_version_matrix for the real per-distro version). Only archlinux:latest ships systemd as PID1-capable in its base image.

packaged_version_matrix.method: ask each distro package manager directly (pacman -Q / rpm -q|dnf info / apt-cache policy) — does not require systemd to run as PID1
packaged_version_matrix.finding: systemd 261 released upstream 2026-06-19. Five weeks later (2026-07-24) only the rolling distro (Arch) actually packages it. LTS (Ubuntu 24.04) is six minor versions behind. The new storage/IMDS/OS-install surface is in the hands of rolling-release users only; 'systemd swallowed OS install' as a headline is separate from 'you can use it on your server today'.

not_measured.runtime_behavior: Binary presence != working feature. Confirmed storagectl/systemd-imdsd exist as files on Arch, but NOT that they fetch cloud IMDS or install an OS end-to-end (container PID1 + no cloud metadata).
not_measured.software_tpm_luo_bpf: systemd-tpm2-swtpm.service, LUO/Kexec Handover, and BPF LSM policy verified only to unit-file / source presence, runtime untested.
not_measured.distro_representativeness: Container images (archlinux:latest, ubuntu:24.04, ...) are the stable-channel default snapshot, not the whole distro. Backports/PPA/rawhide may be newer.

cited_not_measured.claim: The full list of new v261 binaries/services and dlopen migration.
